about_the_game:
EVOLUTION. TAKES. FLIGHT. Become a dinosaur and blast away your enemies with high-tech blaster cannons! Engage in multiplayer PvP aerial combat using rocket thrusters to fly. Outmaneuver and outwit your velociraptor rivals in intense, fast-paced battles.

Millions of years ago, the dinosaurs were wiped out by an asteroid - but what if that fateful asteroid missed Earth completely? VELOCIBLASTER is set in an alternate reality where velociraptors have continued to evolve for millions of years. Today, these dinosaurs are the sentient species on Earth and beyond, and have developed advanced technology enabling them to fly and battle using sci-fi weapons.

Grab your dual high-tech blaster cannons and unleash a variety of exotic, projectile-based weapons to dominate your enemies! VELOCIBLASTER features a multiplayer Deathmatch (free-for-all) game mode with up to 16 players.

Your blaster cannons are equipped with built-in rocket thrusters allowing you to take flight. Master vertical combat and outmaneuver your raptor rivals to claim victory!

FEATURES:

  • Sentient velociraptor dinosaurs equipped with high-tech weapons! 🦖 

  • Action-packed PvP FPS gameplay (up to 16 players) with dedicated servers.

  • Unique flight locomotion with vertical gameplay.

  • Deathmatch (free-for-all) game mode, with more game modes planned for the future.

  • High-quality proximity voice chat with environment voice effects.

  • An advanced projectile-based weapon system.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or greater
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: SteamVR
